title: ScientificGovernorReviewMetric
description: One append-only record per governor review or verification pass. Written by scripts/oracle/governor_metrics.py. Makes the governor's own value auditable: did it catch real defects without false blockers.

recorded_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the record was appended.

case_id.description: Manager Case the reviewed milestone belongs to.

pass_kind.description: First review pass or the post-rework verification pass.

reviews_performed.description: Cumulative passes on this milestone including this one.

findings_accepted.description: Findings the manager acted on / agreed with.

findings_rebutted.description: Findings the manager rebutted with evidence.

findings_deferred.description: Findings recorded as RESIDUAL / deferred, not reworked.

rework_completed_preclosure.description: BLOCKER/MATERIAL findings resolved before the Case closed.

model_consumption_usd.description: Model spend attributed to this pass.

escaped_defects_found_postclosure.description: Defects discovered after closure that this review should have caught — the counter-metric to false blockers.
